title: phlomoides lyrata
intro: Phlomoides lyrata, commonly known as Lycopsis or Lycopsis lyrata, is a type of flowering plant in the mint family (Lamiaceae). The health benefits of Phlomoides lyrata include its potential anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which may contribute to its traditional use in treating various ailments. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to reduce fever, alleviate digestive issues, and exhibit sedative effects, making it a useful remedy for promoting relaxation and relieving stress. The bioactive constituents of Phlomoides lyrata include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
